name: Display Builder
description: An advanced Display Builder for Drupal, require to have a sub module enable to build Entity view, Page or Views.

suggests.drupal/ui_styles: Provide Styles features in Display Builder
suggests.drupal/ui_icons: Provide Icons feature in Display Builder
suggests.drupal/ui_skins: Provide CSS tokens features in Display Builder

project_description: Display Builder is a UI Suite tool that provides a unified, drag-and-drop visual builder for Drupal displays. It replaces Layout Builder for entity view displays, the Block layout for page displays, and the Views display-building UI, letting site builders assemble displays from Single Directory Components (SDC), blocks, fields and pattern presets, with a live in-iframe preview, undo/redo history, publishing/draft workflow and optional real-time collaboration. It is built on UI Patterns 2 sources and integrates with the wider UI Suite (ui_styles, ui_icons, ui_skins) to bring a full design system into Drupal.
